description: Image Description: The image displays a single, handwritten digit "3" in black ink on a white background. The digit is written in a cursive style, with smooth, flowing strokes that form the characteristic shape of the number three. The top curve of the "3" is slightly rounded and loops downward, followed by a second, similar loop below it, creating a continuous, connected appearance. The lines are of uniform thickness, suggesting it was drawn with a steady hand and possibly a pen or marker
